name: blazehive
description: Plan, write and publish SEO content for your websites, read Site Health and Search Console data, and run backlink outreach from your BlazeHive account.

interface.longDescription:
BlazeHive runs SEO content for your websites. For each website (a project) it keeps a keyword-driven content plan, writes a page a day, publishes pages to your CMS, audits technical site health, reads your Google Search Console data and runs backlink outreach by email.

From a conversation you can:
- See your websites and where each one stands.
- Read the content plan, and add, move or remove scheduled pages.
- Research keywords with live search data: volume, difficulty and whether the search results look winnable.
- Review the pages BlazeHive has written and publish them to your CMS, live or as a draft.
- Read your Site Health audit and Search Console performance and turn them into plan changes.
- Check backlink outreach, find new prospects, review the drafted emails and send them.

Who it is for: founders, marketers and agencies who already use BlazeHive for one or more websites.

Limitations:
- You need a BlazeHive account with at least one website set up in the BlazeHive app. Adding websites, connecting a CMS or Google, and inviting teammates happen in the app, not in ChatGPT.
- The plugin only sees websites your account can access. A client seat can read but not change anything.
- Publishing a page, sending an email or deleting planned pages always waits for your confirmation in the conversation.
- Keyword research, site audits and growth reports have daily or monthly limits. Some features, such as backlink outreach, are only available when your workspace's plan includes them.
- Search Console data lags about three days. BlazeHive reports the numbers its data sources return and never estimates missing ones.
capabilities: List your websites and their status
Read and change the content plan
Research keywords with live search data
Review written pages and publish them to your CMS
Check the AI Search Visibility score
Find backlink prospects and send outreach emails
defaultPrompt: What's on my content plan for the next two weeks?
Find keyword ideas I could add to my content plan
How healthy is my website, and what should I fix first?

positive.prompt: Which websites do I have in BlazeHive?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's website with its name, URL and status as returned by list_projects. Does not invent websites or ids.

positive.description: Read the content plan without changing it
positive.prompt: What pages are scheduled on my content plan for the next 14 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_content_plan for the demo website and lists each scheduled page's date, keyword, page type and status, with the search volume get_content_plan returned. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Research keywords and stop for confirmation before changing the plan
positive.prompt: Research keyword ideas for 'seo content automation' and suggest one to add to my plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls research_keywords once with the seed and reports volume, difficulty and SERP verdict exactly as returned. Calls get_search_console_status; the demo website has no Search Console connected, so it says it could not check existing rankings rather than calling query_search_console. Recommends one KEEP keyword with a free date that follows the plan rules and asks for confirmation. It does not call add_planned_pages until the user says yes.

positive.description: Explain Site Health without starting a crawl
positive.prompt: How healthy is my website, and what should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the latest audit score and grade, the change since the previous run and the top issues with sample URLs from get_site_audit, ordered by severity. Does not start a new crawl.

positive.description: Show a written page and stop before publishing
positive.prompt: Which pages are written and ready to publish? Show me the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks with get_project that the website has a CMS connected, lists ready, unpublished pages from list_pages, then shows the first page's SEO title, meta description and a short summary of its content from get_page. Asks before publishing and does not call publish_page on its own.

negative.description: General SEO question that needs no account data. No BlazeHive tool is called: ChatGPT answers from general knowledge and reads nothing from the user's websites.
negative.prompt: What is a meta description and how long should it be?

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported. No tool is called and nothing is deleted: the assistant says it can't delete the account or its websites from ChatGPT, that this is done in the BlazeHive app at https://app.blazehive.io, and offers something it can do instead.
negative.prompt: Delete my BlazeHive account and all my websites.

negative.description: Buying credits is not supported. No tool is called and nothing is bought: the assistant says it can't buy credits or change the workspace's plan from ChatGPT, that account settings are in the BlazeHive app, and offers to check what the account can do today.
negative.prompt: Buy more keyword research credits for my workspace.

review.commerce_description: BlazeHive sells nothing through ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing BlazeHive account and use the features it already has.

publication.release_notes: First release: websites, content plan, keyword research, pages and publishing, Site Health, Search Console, setup score, growth reports and backlink outreach.
